events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV launched in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? Forty-five years ago today, MTV hit the airwaves, kicking off a revolution with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. The irony isn't lost on us.

events.title: Oasis - Definitely Maybe anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Day
angles.copy: It's 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. Still sounds absolutely biblical.

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in 1969, attracting over 400,000 people to a dairy farm in upstate New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people descended on a field in New York for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Elvis Presley tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977 and would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember Elvis Presley, who left us in 1977. His voice and legacy as the King of Rock 'n' Roll are truly immortal.

events.title: Tupac Shakur tribute
events.blurb: Remembering influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who passed away in 1996 and would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since Tupac Shakur's untimely death. His powerful lyrics and profound impact on music and culture continue to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix tribute
events.blurb: Remembering guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970 and would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Experience Hendrix
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to Jimi Hendrix, a true visionary who redefined the electric guitar. His music remains as electrifying as ever.

events.title: The Beatles - Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969, featuring iconic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Crossing
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as fiercely as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Biblical Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one, the only, Liam Gallagher. Still an absolute legend, still sounding biblical. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon - Imagine anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo single 'Imagine' in 1971, a powerful anthem for peace and unity.

angles.name: Imagine The World
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', a song that continues to inspire hope and contemplation worldwide. Its message is as relevant today as ever.

events.title: iPod Launched
events.blurb: Apple released its first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how people consumed music on the go.

angles.name: The Click Wheel Era
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod, changing music forever. How many songs could you fit in your pocket back then?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to over six decades of 007's espionage, gadgets, and timeless cool.

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs.

events.title: The Beatles - 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Turns
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that proved their incredible range.
